convention: lat: degrees North (south is negative). lon: degrees East, -180..180 (west is negative). Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

sources.usgs-square-center: Centre of the USGS region square for each Artemis III candidate region, as listed by MoonSnag Mission Watch (https://moonsnag.com/coordination, retrieved 2026-11-14). The squares come from McClernan 2024, USGS data release https://doi.org/10.5066/P1MEQ6UK (regions sourced from LROC QuickMap). NASA itself published names and a map, not coordinates (NTRS 20250011660; NASA news release 2024-10-28).
sources.lunar-surface-data-book: Approximate centres from realestateonthemoon.com/lunar-south-pole (retrieved 2026-11-14), which cites NASA's Lunar Surface Data Book and LROC mosaics. Used only as a cross-check.
sources.nssdca-apollo: NASA NSSDCA Apollo Landing Site Coordinates, Lunar Module positions measured in LRO images (Wagner et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 92-103). https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/lunar_sites.html

sites.name: Mons Mouton Plateau
sites.note: Largest region (about ±58 km), so its centre is only indicative.

sites.name: Slater Plain
sites.note: Cross-check differs by about 25 km; that value is the crater the plain lies north of, so the USGS-square centre is kept.
